note: Multi-word values whose non-English form is legitimately identical to English: product and protocol names, code samples, units, interpolation-only strings, and a count whose word is spelled the same in the language ("{{count}} error" in Spanish, "{{count}} partitions" in French). Section 4 of check-i18n-parity.ts filters out single-word values on its own, so an entry only belongs here when its en.json value has two words or more.
